subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should the remaining fix for this issue be a narrow Telegram plain-group `updateLastRoute` repair, the broader shared non-direct delivery-context fallback, or deferred until live Telegram restart proof is captured?
rationale: Current source supports the reported plain-group gap, but the narrow Telegram fix and broader shared fallback have different channel compatibility and ownership risks.

options.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
options.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof first, then repair Telegram plain-group route persistence without changing shared fallback behavior unless the repro points there.

options.title: Adopt shared fallback
options.body: Use the shared non-direct delivery-context fallback as canonical, but require compatibility review across channel plugins before merge.

options.title: Wait for live repro
options.body: Keep the issue in needs-live-repro until a maintainer or reporter captures current-main restart evidence.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
recommendation.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof first, then repair Telegram plain-group route persistence without changing shared fallback behavior unless the repro points there.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the shared inbound session recorder and Telegram route-persistence boundary that this history ties most strongly to Peter Steinberger.
